description: Adding zero on the right leaves a natural number unchanged.
leanCode: theorem add_zero (n : Nat) : n + 0 = n := rfl

description: Adding zero on the left leaves a natural number unchanged.
leanCode: theorem zero_add (n : Nat) : 0 + n = n := by omega

description: A number added to itself equals twice that number.
leanCode: theorem add_self (n : Nat) : n + n = 2 * n := by omega

description: A seed proof showing that natural number addition can be rearranged using commutativity.
leanCode:
theorem seed_add_rearrange (a b c : Nat) : (a + b) + c = c + (b + a) := by
  calc
    (a + b) + c = c + (a + b) := by
      rw [Nat.add_comm]
    _ = c + (b + a) := by
      rw [Nat.add_comm a b]
